summary: Built and tried `desk:apps:book`; it works, and testing saved “Mir” and “Zoe” to `desk:guestbook`.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest Book'
task decorate(names)
set out to []
set row to 3
for each n in reverse(names)
add {row: row, name: n} to out
set row to row + 1
done
give out
done
task start()
set guests to []
when exists('desk:guestbook')
set guests to lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
done
give {guests: guests, display: decorate(guests), name: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'enter' and s.name is not ''
add('desk:guestbook', s.name)
add s.name to s.guests
set s.display to decorate(s.guests)
set s.name to ''
or when k is 'backspace'
set s.name to edit_text(s.name, k)
or when count(k) is 1
set s.name to edit_text(s.name, k)
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
title('Guest Book')
show(1, 1, count(s.guests) & ' guests')
for each g in s.display
when g.row <= 22
show(g.row, 1, g.name)
done
done
show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.name)
done
